policy: English originals only; zero translated books; original multilingual passages preserved.

koreanTerm.finding: Korea Copyright Commission explains the general term as life plus 70 years, calculated from January 1 of the year following death. All selected principal authors died by 1946, so even the conservative 70-year calculation has elapsed by 2026.

reuse.finding: CC0 permits copying, modification, distribution and performance, including commercial use. Each selected official Standard Ebooks repository has its own LICENSE.md dedicating contributor rights under CC0 and stating its source text is believed to be US public domain. No artwork or font is exported.
